g.text: SRA3 320 x 450 - 15 sets (A + B) = 15 guests per sheet + slot test strip (coupons 0.60 / 0.70 / 0.80 / 0.90).
B turned 180 deg and nested over the dome of A (same R119, 4.5 mm gap). Pitch 104 x 75.5, web 4 mm, long grain (450) = vertical on both plates.
Pre-coloured lemon board: no bleed. Slip a scrap of the production board into each coupon slit and choose the width that holds without force.
